title: cotinus radicans
intro: Cotinus radicans, commonly known as the American smoketree or smokebush, is a deciduous shrub native to eastern North America. This plant is prized for its stunning purple smoke-like foliage that appears when its leaves are exposed to wind or heat. The American smoketree has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Cotinus radicans include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
